books.intro: Each book has its own tax and currency settings. Use separate books for private and business activity; use separate Kassiber files for different clients.

workspace.empty: No books in this set yet.

create.title: New book
create.descriptionFromSource: Create a separate book in {{workspace}} from {{source}}'s tax settings.
create.descriptionInWorkspace: Create a separate book in {{workspace}} and choose its region and accounting method.
create.descriptionDefault: Create a separate book using default settings.
create.copyHint: Copies only tax policy, currency, holding period and lot selection. Wallets, accounts and transactions stay in the original book.
create.austrianMethodNote: Austrian books use the moving-average method (gleitender Durchschnittspreis) by default. Other methods are available but not standard for Austria.

renameProfile.title: Book settings
renameProfile.description: Rename the book or change its region, accounting method and cost-basis pool scope. Changing tax settings reprocesses journals so reports recompute.
renameProfile.poolScopeNote: Changing the scope invalidates journals so reports can be recomputed.
renameProfile.poolScopeLockedNote: Only the country policy's reviewed global scope is currently available.
renameProfile.austrianMethodNote: Austrian books use the moving-average method (gleitender Durchschnittspreis) by default. Other methods are available but not standard for Austria.

switchRegion.title: Switch region?
switchRegion.body: Change this book from {{from}} to {{to}}, resetting the accounting method to {{method}}.
switchRegion.warning: All journals are reprocessed so reports recompute.

method.MOVING_AVERAGE_FIFO_PERIOD: Average cost per wallet, holding period by FIFO
method.UK_SHARE_MATCHING: UK share matching (same day, 30 days, pool)

renameWorkspace.title: Edit book set name
renameWorkspace.description: Rename this book set. Books, wallets, and transactions stay unchanged.

createWorkspace.title: New book set
createWorkspace.description: A separate set of books in this data folder. Most people only need one.

settings.description: Changes apply to this book only. You see what will change before anything is saved.
settings.loadError: Could not load this book's settings.
settings.afterSwitch: Save the region first; you can change this afterwards.

currency.note: The currency gains, losses and cost basis are reported in.
currency.invalid: Enter a three-letter currency code, for example EUR or USD.

taxYear.customHint: Month and day, for example 10-01 for 1 October.
taxYear.customInvalid: Enter a date as MM-DD, for example 07-01. 29 February can't be used.
taxYear.zoneNote: Tax years and days begin at midnight in this time zone.
taxYear.locked: {{country}} books follow the legal tax year, so it can't be changed.

pool.label: Cost basis pool

global.label: Whole book (total)
global.help: One pool per coin across all wallets: a sale uses the book's cost basis, whichever wallet it leaves.

wallet.label: Per wallet
wallet.help: Each wallet keeps its own pool: a sale uses only that wallet's cost basis, and moving coins takes their cost basis along.

global_then_wallet.label: Whole book, then per wallet from 2025
global_then_wallet.help: One pool until the end of 2024; on 1 January 2025 its remaining cost basis is split across the wallets.

pool.only: This is the only pool {{country}} books can use.
pool.perCoin: Each coin is pooled on its own: BTC and L-BTC never share a pool. Cost basis moves between them only as set under Review options.

holding.note: Coins held longer than this count as long-term.
holding.invalid: Enter a whole number of days, 0 or more.
holding.oneYear: {{country}}: coins held for more than one year count as long-term.
holding.never: {{country}} books don't use a long-term holding period.

fields.label: Name
fields.bitcoin_rail_carrying_value: Carry cost basis between BTC and L-BTC

preview.title: Review changes
preview.description: {{name}}: nothing is saved until you apply.
preview.reprocess_one: Journals are reprocessed for {{count}} transaction before reports are up to date again.
preview.reprocess_other: Journals are reprocessed for {{count}} transactions before reports are up to date again.
preview.firstRun: Journals use the new settings when they are first processed.
preview.regrouped: Gains and income are regrouped into tax years starting {{start}}.
preview.held_one: {{count}} transaction is priced in {{from}} and waits for review until it has a {{to}} price.
preview.held_other: {{count}} transactions are priced in {{from}} and wait for review until they have a {{to}} price.
preview.filed_one: {{count}} filed report may no longer match. It stays as it was filed.
preview.filed_other: {{count}} filed reports may no longer match. They stay as they were filed.
preview.calendarReset: The book's own tax year is reset to {{country}}'s.

errors.methodScopeUnsupported: This accounting method can't be used with that cost basis pool. Choose another method or pool.
errors.taxYearStartInvalid: That start date isn't valid. Use MM-DD; 29 February can't be used.
errors.taxYearStartLocked: This region's tax year can't be changed.
errors.timezoneLocked: This region's time zone can't be changed.
errors.bookSwitched: The open book changed while this was open. Close and try again.

frame.setupConnects: Setup connects to nothing unless you test a server.

start.headline: Your Bitcoin books, kept on your machine.

openExisting.title: Open existing books
openExisting.tooltipUnavailable: Opening existing books is available in the desktop app

regtest.title: Open regtest demo
regtest.body: Skip setup and open the demo book on the local regtest Docker stack.

tryDemo.title: Try the demo
tryDemo.tooltip: Open a sample book with wallets, reports and evidence. Separate from your own books; nothing is downloaded.

import.title: Open existing books
import.rightBody: Kassiber now uses the selected data folder. Once a book opens, the rest of the app works from it.
import.empty: No books in this data folder.

default.title: Built-in Bitcoin servers
default.description: Explorer API and Electrum / Fulcrum, run by Bitcoin Austria.
default.tradeoff: The operator sees which addresses you look up.

custom.title: Your own server
custom.description: Your own Esplora, Electrum / Fulcrum, Bitcoin Core or Liquid server, over clearnet or Tor.
custom.tradeoff: Only that server sees your addresses.

skip.title: Offline
skip.description: No sync, AI or update checks. Imports and reports still work.

connections.useSslDescription: Most servers use TLS on port 50002.
connections.trustSslDescription: Unsafe. Only for a server you control.
connections.certificateIgnored: Ignored while TLS certificate verification is disabled.
connections.certificateSystemStore: Leave empty to use the system certificate store.
connections.useProxyDescription: Route only this server through Tor, SOCKS or an HTTP proxy.
connections.onionDetectedBody: Uses the local Tor proxy at 127.0.0.1:9050 for this server only.
connections.testHint: Optional: checks that the server is reachable.
connections.credentialsWarning: Don't paste tokens, passwords or cookies here. Add them after setup.

local.title: Local model
local.description: Ollama, oMLX or another OpenAI-compatible server on this device.

remote.title: Remote provider
remote.description: An OpenAI-compatible API or a subscription app (Codex, Claude, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot). Prompts and book context leave this device.

ai.providerPrivacyDescription: TEE providers claim a trusted-execution path. Kassiber still treats them as off-device.
ai.baseUrlDescription: An OpenAI Responses-compatible /v1 address, or a CLI locator such as claude-cli://default.
ai.remoteAck: I understand prompts may leave this device.
ai.remoteAckDescription: Labels, notes, hostnames and report details can be sensitive.

security.title: Protect your books
security.lead: Encryption protects your books on this device with a passphrase. Kassiber cannot recover a lost passphrase.

plaintext.title: Unencrypted
plaintext.description: Anyone with disk access can read it. For testing only.

strength.weak: Easy to guess. Several unrelated words make a stronger passphrase.
strength.fair: Could be stronger. Add a few characters or another word.

security.passphraseNote: Used only on this device to unlock the database; never saved by the app.
security.recoveryAck: I have stored this passphrase somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
security.recoveryAckDescription: Kassiber cannot reset it. Without it, these books cannot be opened.
security.touchIdDescription: Saves your passphrase in the macOS Keychain, readable only after Touch ID. The CLI is set up separately.
security.migrateCredentials: Move saved backend credentials into the encrypted database.
security.migrateCredentialsDescription: For an existing CLI setup: reads them from backends.env.
security.plaintextAck: I understand plaintext mode is not for real wallet data.
security.plaintextAckDescription: Balances, addresses and labels are readable from disk.

sync.title: Choose sync connections
sync.updateChecksDescription: GitHub sees your IP address, Kassiber version and the time.

tax.noteAtCustom: Differs from the Austrian defaults (EUR, moving average).

sync.noteDefaultLoading: Backend addresses are loading from Kassiber.

ai.noteRemote: Receives the book context you approve.

updates.noteEnabled: GitHub sees your IP address, Kassiber version and the time.

storage.noteEncrypted: Passphrase required. Touch ID {{touchId}}. A lost passphrase cannot be recovered.
storage.notePlaintext: Readable by anyone with disk access.

secrets.noteEncrypted: Credentials from backends.env move into the encrypted database.

others.value: Live prices, exchange imports, BTCPay, Lightning

network.label: {{reach}} · {{when}}
network.offUntilSetUp: Off until you set it up
